name: io.github.computeisgod/mcp-computeflux
title: ComputeFlux
description: Zero-dependency MCP server exposing ComputeFlux (an OpenAI-compatible, TEE-verifiable multi-model inference gateway deployed on the Polkadot testnet) to any MCP host. Two tools: list models, and run a chat completion over one OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: COMPUTEFLUX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer key for the OpenAI-compatible endpoint (required).

environmentVariables.name: COMPUTEFLUX_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL. Defaults to https://api.computeflux.ai/v1.
